lines.en: I walk the red earth of the badlands.
Each step raises a sheet of dust.

lines.zh: 我身子往前压，尾巴在后面拖。
lines.en: I lean forward, tail trailing.

lines.zh: 我绕过风化的石柱，不撞。
lines.en: I skirt the weathered pillars without striking them.
I walk slowly, but each stride is long.
The gully's too deep; I follow its edge.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，碎石被踩碎。
lines.en: Where I pass, gravel breaks underfoot.

lines.zh: 我伸头嗅了嗅前面的空气。
lines.en: I stretch my neck to test the air ahead.

lines.zh: 我顺着坡下去，脚掌很宽。
lines.en: I go down the slope on broad feet.
I turn to check my flank.

lines.zh: 我停下，前脚搭在一块石头上。
lines.en: I stop with a forefoot on a rock.
It's dry here. I don't like it.

lines.zh: 我从一座石拱下面走过去。
lines.en: I pass beneath a stone arch.

lines.zh: 我最后停在一道高坎边上。
lines.en: I stop at the edge of a high bank.
I stand with my head low.
I open my jaws to shed heat.
My nostrils open and close.
A tumbleweed rolls past in the distance.
I crouch in the shade.

lines.zh: 我的牙齿上还挂着一点东西。
lines.en: Something's still caught in my teeth.
I run my tongue along my teeth.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一块赤色的岩。
lines.en: Held still, I look like a red boulder.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴在地上摆了一下。
lines.en: I swing my tail once on the ground.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一直盯着地平线。
lines.en: My eyes stay on the horizon.
No water here. I'll remember that.
I close my jaws slowly.

lines.zh: 我站在干河床里，尘土绕着脚。
lines.en: I stand in the dry riverbed, dust circling my feet.

lines.zh: 我抬脚又放下，地响了一下。
lines.en: I lift a foot, set it down, and the ground thuds.
You're pitifully small.
I lower my head to your level.

lines.zh: 你站在我的影子里，很暗。
lines.en: You're in my shadow. Very dim.

lines.zh: 我不急着追，你跑不远的。
lines.en: I won't rush. You won't get far.

lines.zh: 你手里那根棍子，挡不住我。
lines.en: That stick in your hand won't stop me.
I come to these badlands often.

lines.zh: 我在红土上走，每一步都扬起尘。
lines.en: I walk the red earth, dust rising each step.

lines.zh: 我的上颚比你的头还长。
lines.en: My upper jaw is longer than your head.

lines.zh: 你退了，我跟着挪了一步。
lines.en: You backed up; I shifted one step.
Don't point that at me.
Two legs, one set of jaws.
Good. Don't move.
I sway and give half a step.
The hide on my flank is cut open.
I shake my head and blood flies.

lines.zh: 我吼了一声，恶地的石头都震。
lines.en: I roar, and the badlands stones shake.

lines.zh: 我缩起脖子，把喉咙藏到肩后。
lines.en: I pull my neck in, tucking my throat behind my shoulder.
I pull my weight back.
It hurts. My jaws still work.
You've more nerve than you look.
I grit my teeth and make no second sound.
I'll remember you for that.
That's not enough to fill a tooth.
You're bleeding. I can smell it.
I come forward slowly, not to startle you.
You're holding that up. I'm not afraid.
When it moves, I want to move.
A little closer and I can reach.
That flesh of yours is warm.
I can eat anything.
I flatten and press in.
Right. I'm done waiting.
You hit my leg like a post.
I hardly noticed.
I turn and my tail sweeps you.

lines.zh: 这一下把你推出去两米。
lines.en: That shoved you two metres.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，给你让出一条缝。
lines.en: I turn side-on and leave you a gap.
Don't stand against my feet.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，你退了一步。
lines.en: I look down; you take a step back.
Between us we've raised a dust cloud.
I shift a step and the ground dips.
I'll let that pass.
I'm the only one on this patch.

lines.zh: 同类来了也得先比一场。
lines.en: Any of my kind would have to fight me first.
A body this size doesn't pair easily.
Beat me first, then we talk.

lines.zh: 我在这块地盘待了很多年。
lines.en: I've held this ground for many years.

lines.zh: 恶地没什么好，只是没人抢。
lines.en: Nothing good here, but no one competes.
If you stay, I won't drive you off.
I speak little. I roar more.
When it cools, we'll talk again.

lines.zh: 我嘴上厉害，其实守着这块地。
lines.en: I'm fierce of jaw, but I keep to this ground.
I dip my head and take it easily.

lines.zh: 这点东西在我嘴里太小了。
lines.en: It's tiny in my jaws.
I carry it behind a stone.
I'll keep the bone and gnaw at it.
What fell in the gully, I won't go down for.
I curl my tongue and draw it in.

lines.zh: 太硬，我咬了一下就放下了。
lines.en: Too hard. One bite and I leave it.
A badlands giant jaw goes for the big ones.

lines.zh: 我把它按在脚下，恶地的石头也裂。
lines.en: I pin it underfoot; even badlands stone cracks.
Stowed for when I'm hungry.
There's a new shadow in the dust.
A badlands giant with thick teeth.
You shouldn't be in this place.

lines.zh: 我在恶地上生活得太久，先打再说。
lines.en: Too long in the badlands. I strike first.
I lift a foot and press one step in.

lines.zh: 你跑起来，尘土会挡住你。
lines.en: Run and the dust will blind you.
I'm behind you, downwind.
It's only two strides.
I count the steps you've already taken.
Right. I've fixed on you.

lines.zh: 这里没有遮蔽，你藏不住。
lines.en: No cover here. You can't hide.
My jaws are wider than your shield.

lines.zh: 你举起手的样子，我看清了。
lines.en: I see how you raise your hands.
I drop my head and coil my forelegs.
I take a stride and the ground shakes.
The faster you retreat, the less I hurry.
I circle to the flank and the wind helps me.
The gully limits where you can go.

lines.zh: 我压得很低，头伸在前面。
lines.en: I keep low, head thrust forward.
You're holding that shield stiffly.

lines.zh: 恶地的霸王，比暴龙还大。
lines.en: A badland tyrant larger than rex.
The red earth under you is loose.

lines.zh: 我踩碎挡路的石块，继续走。
lines.en: I crush the stones in my way and keep walking.
The way you hold that shield is stiff.
Two more strides and I reach.
The more you retreat, the narrower it gets.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴甩到一边，准备冲。
lines.en: I swing my tail aside to charge.

lines.zh: 你的步伐已经不像样了。
lines.en: Your stride has come apart.
One opening is all I need.
This instant. Right now.
I don't like dragging things out.

lines.zh: 我张嘴咬下去，牙齿合拢。
lines.en: I bite down and my teeth close.

lines.zh: 这一下带着冲过来的力。
lines.en: That had my charge behind it.
I shake my head and throw you aside.

lines.zh: 我的脚踩下去，尘土炸开。
lines.en: My foot comes down and the dust bursts.

lines.zh: 你挡了，盾牌凹进去一块。
lines.en: You blocked it; your shield buckled.

lines.zh: 我咬空了，牙碰在一起很响。
lines.en: I bite air and my teeth clack loudly.
That caught you across the back.
I lower my head and ram again.
My tail sweeps your legs.
I don't pause. Again.
A plate of your armor has sprung loose.
I step back and open my jaws again.

lines.zh: 我的头一甩，你整个人飞出去。
lines.en: One swing of my head throws you off your feet.
Still standing? Not bad.
The next bite won't miss.
Right. It's done.

lines.zh: 我从红土裂口里站起来。
lines.en: I rise out of a crack in the red earth.

lines.zh: 恶地的热风先吹到我身上。
lines.en: The badlands' hot wind hits me first.

lines.zh: 我落地，尘土像墙一样立起来。
lines.en: I land and dust rises like a wall.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖脖子，砂岩碎屑落下。
lines.en: I shake my neck and sandstone grit falls.

lines.zh: 这一带没有水，也没有别的脚印。
lines.en: No water, no other tracks here.

lines.zh: 我把头抬起来，越过石柱看。
lines.en: I raise my head to look over the pillars.
My shadow covers half a gully.
I scuff my feet on the red earth.
I know every pillar out there.
I open my jaws to shed heat.
This patch of badlands is mine.
I turn slowly for a full look.
The dust settles and there I stand.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸把红土吹起一点。
lines.en: My breath lifts a little of the red dust.
Two steps and the ground trembles.
Empty enough for me to move.

lines.zh: 火在皮上燎过，气味难闻。
lines.en: Fire passes over my hide and the smell is foul.

lines.zh: 我从高坎上摔下去，砸碎了石头。
lines.en: I fall off the bank and shatter stone.

lines.zh: 这身骨头太重，一进水就沉。
lines.en: This much bone sinks at once in water.
The blast rolls me onto my side.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我的脖子侧面。
lines.en: An arrow buries in the side of my neck.
That force locks my legs.

lines.zh: 恶地上没东西吃，我越来越轻。
lines.en: Nothing to eat here; I grow lighter.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，我腿都软了。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and my legs weaken.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有落脚的地方，我一直在坠。
lines.en: Nothing to stand on in the void. I just keep falling.
